messages:
olivia: kicking off blue/green for router-edge v3.4.0 at 2026-03-22T01:00Z. change-window 1h. goal: preserve cookie affinity for sticky sessions during shift. plan: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%. fallback: immediate rollback to v3.3.9 if error-rate > 1.5% or p99 spike.

deploy-bot: PRECHECKS: services healthy, canary infra=ok, last deploy age=3d. starting shift now: moving 10%.

mike: FYI the LB supports cookie persistence but we need to extend TTL to 15m for this release. ops-oncall can we toggle?

ops-oncall: yes can flip cookie-ttl. doing that now: /ops toggle cookie-ttl router-edge 15m -> applied. watching for session reconnects.

infra-bot: NOTE: notifying CDN to respect session cookie: sent purge request for session routes.

sara: running smoke tests (login, upload, downstream calls). first pass ok but seeing intermittent 502s on node-12 in us-west. small blips, not widespread. logs show retry backoff kicking in.

mike: add a short backoff cap change to prevent retry storms: will set max-retries=3 for 15m. command: `kubectl patch cm router-config -p '{"data":{"max_retries":"3"}}'`

deploy-bot: STEP 2 -> ramp to 30% blocked by warmup condition. kv_replication_lag must be <500ms for 3m. current lag=720ms. holding.

ops-oncall: investigating replication lag with db team. ETA ~5m to catch up. increasing watch on queue-depth and replica-lag.

olivia: ok hold. no further steps until lag < 500ms and session-tests pass. tag me when green.

deploy-bot: replication lag dropped to 310ms. warmup satisfied. proceeding to 30%.

sara: post-30% smoke: login flows fine, uploads ok, 502s gone. p95 increased from 120ms->135ms, acceptable.

mike: applying retry cap now to avoid cascades. patched config, reload sent.

deploy-bot: ramp 60% -> in progress.

ops-oncall: monitoring: p99 spiked to 620ms briefly at 60% for 45s but error-rate stayed <0.5%. rollback threshold not hit. continuing.

infra-bot: housekeeping: published release notes draft -> https://docs.internal/releases/router-edge-v3.4.0 (contains cookie TTL change, retry cap, kv warmup note).

olivia: once we hit 100% remember to pin traffic in /traffic/pins and create followup ticket to lower cookie TTL back to 10m in 48h if stable.

deploy-bot: final step -> shifting to 100%. deployment complete at 2026-03-22T01:12:00Z. post-checks: smoke ok, error-rate nominal. :tada:

mike: thanks team. will open PR for reverting TTL later.

ops-oncall: leaving a watch window until 02:30Z. will escalate if thresholds breached.
